scope: Native Windows hidden top-level window; synthetic messages to owned test window only, no real logoff/shutdown or task registration
rules: WM_QUERYENDSESSION returns TRUE immediately without cleanup
WM_ENDSESSION FALSE leaves sessions and admission unchanged
WM_ENDSESSION TRUE freezes admission and synchronously stops owned trees and checkpoints before returning
Repeated confirmed end does not duplicate terminal events; both owned sessions persist stopped
Disposable-runner login-task probe targets only the held owner-checked pipe server process and verifies its image, class and window PID before bounded messages
Existing console close/logoff/shutdown handlers remain registered
No new protocol, schema, stop reason or replay
acceptanceLimit: In-process synthetic messages do not prove login-task delivery. The separately opted-in hosted-runner probe checks delivery to the real task process, not actual Windows logoff/shutdown.
